# BeatGrid { #timetoalign.timelines.BeatGrid }

```python
timelines.BeatGrid(segments, *, extent=None)
```

A sequence of tempo segments and the beats they generate.

Segments are given as they are stated — typically without an end,
each one generating beats forever. The grid puts them in time order
and bounds each by the next one's start; the last segment is bounded
by *extent*, or generates without end when no extent is given.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from fractions import Fraction
>>> grid = BeatGrid.from_tempo(120, extent=8)
>>> [str(beat.seconds) for beat in grid.iter_beats()][:5]
['0', '1/2', '1', '3/2', '2']
>>> grid.seconds_at(2)
Coordinate(2.0, seconds)
>>> grid.position_at(2.75).instant
Coordinate(2.5, seconds)
>>> grid.position_at(2.75).instant == grid.seconds_at(2, 2)
True
```

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [extent](#timetoalign.timelines.BeatGrid.extent) | Exclusive bound of the grid in seconds, or ``None``. |
| [n_measures](#timetoalign.timelines.BeatGrid.n_measures) | How many measures the grid's beats fall into. |
| [n_segments](#timetoalign.timelines.BeatGrid.n_segments) | How many tempo segments the grid holds. |
| [segments](#timetoalign.timelines.BeatGrid.segments) | The segments in time order, each bounded by its successor. |

### export_to_csv { #timetoalign.timelines.BeatGrid.export_to_csv }

```python
timelines.BeatGrid.export_to_csv(filepath, *, format, labels='beats')
```

Write the grid's beats in an audio tool's annotation format.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                                             | Description                                                                                                                                                       | Default    |
|----------|------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| filepath | [str](`str`) \| [Path](`pathlib.Path`)                           | Where to write the file.                                                                                                                                          | _required_ |
| format   | [Literal](`typing.Literal`)\[\'sonic_visualiser\', \'tilia\'\]   | ``"sonic_visualiser"`` writes a ``TIME``/``LABEL`` label track; ``"tilia"`` writes a beat track with ``time``, ``measure``, ``beat`` and ``is_first_in_measure``. | _required_ |
| labels   | [Literal](`typing.Literal`)\[\'beats\', \'measures\', \'both\'\] | For the label track, whether to mark every beat (``"M1B2"``), only the downbeats (``"M1"``), or both.                                                             | `'beats'`  |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                 |
|--------|--------------|-----------------------------|
|        | [int](`int`) | How many rows were written. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                             |
|--------|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If *format* or *labels* is not recognised, or if the grid is unbounded. |

### from_tempo { #timetoalign.timelines.BeatGrid.from_tempo }

```python
timelines.BeatGrid.from_tempo(
    bpm,
    *,
    metro='4/4',
    start=0,
    battito=1,
    extent=None,
    policy=None,
)
```

Build a single-segment grid from one tempo statement.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                                                                                 | Description                                                                                   | Default    |
|---------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| bpm     | [int](`int`) \| [float](`float`) \| [Fraction](`fractions.Fraction`) \| [str](`str`) | Beats per minute of the lattice.                                                              | _required_ |
| metro   | [str](`str`)                                                                         | Meter as ``"n/d"``, read as ``n`` beats of ``4/d`` quarters. Ignored when *policy* is given.  | `'4/4'`    |
| start   | [SecondsSpec](`timetoalign.timelines.beatgrid.SecondsSpec`)                          | Seconds of the anchor beat.                                                                   | `0`        |
| battito | [int](`int`)                                                                         | 1-based beat-in-bar index of the anchor beat.                                                 | `1`        |
| extent  | [SecondsSpec](`timetoalign.timelines.beatgrid.SecondsSpec`) \| None                  | Exclusive bound in seconds. ``None`` leaves the grid unbounded, generating beats without end. | `None`     |
| policy  | [BeatPolicy](`timetoalign.core.BeatPolicy`) \| None                                  | An explicit counting policy, overriding *metro*.                                              | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                  | Description           |
|--------|-------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------|
|        | [BeatGrid](`timetoalign.timelines.beatgrid.BeatGrid`) | The one-segment grid. |

### get_beat_table { #timetoalign.timelines.BeatGrid.get_beat_table }

```python
timelines.BeatGrid.get_beat_table(segment=None, numbering='set')
```

Render the grid's beats as a table.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                | Description                                                                                                      | Default   |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| segment   | [int](`int`) \| None                                | Restrict the table to one segment's beats.                                                                       | `None`    |
| numbering | [Literal](`typing.Literal`)\[\'set\', \'segment\'\] | Whether the ``measure`` column counts across the whole grid (``"set"``) or restarts per segment (``"segment"``). | `'set'`   |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                           | Description                                                 |
|--------|------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [pd](`pandas`).[DataFrame](`pandas.DataFrame`) | One row per beat with the columns ``seconds``, ``segment``, |
|        | [pd](`pandas`).[DataFrame](`pandas.DataFrame`) | ``segment_seconds``, ``measure`` and ``beat``.              |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                 |
|--------|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the grid is unbounded, if *segment* names no segment, or if *numbering* is not one of the two spellings. |

### position_at { #timetoalign.timelines.BeatGrid.position_at }

```python
timelines.BeatGrid.position_at(seconds, *, policy=None)
```

Return the beat sounding at *seconds*.

The beat whose span contains the position, that is the last beat
at or before it.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                                                        | Description                                                                                                                      | Default    |
|---------|-------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| seconds | [SecondsSpec](`timetoalign.timelines.beatgrid.SecondsSpec`) | A position on the grid's seconds axis.                                                                                           | _required_ |
| policy  | [BeatPolicy](`timetoalign.core.BeatPolicy`) \| None         | Read the beat index under this counting instead of the grid's own lattice. The measure numbering and the segment are unaffected. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                  | Description                                 |
|--------|-------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------|
|        | [GridBeat](`timetoalign.timelines.beatgrid.GridBeat`) | The beat, carrying both measure numberings. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                              |
|--------|----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the position lies before the grid's first beat or at/after its extent, or if *policy* does not reach the position within its measure. |

### quarters_between { #timetoalign.timelines.BeatGrid.quarters_between }

```python
timelines.BeatGrid.quarters_between(start_seconds, end_seconds)
```

Integrate exact quarter-note length over a seconds interval.

Each segment contributes its own tempo. **The domain is
``[0, extent]``** — ``[0, inf)`` on an unbounded grid — closed at
both ends, so the extent itself may be named even though no beat
sounds there. A grid that opens late still reads the seconds
before it, at its first segment's tempo: that stretch carries the
anchor the floating-measure lattice hangs on. Outside the domain
the grid states no tempo, and this raises rather than
extrapolating, exactly as the seconds direction does.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type                                                        | Description                | Default    |
|---------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------|------------|
| start_seconds | [SecondsSpec](`timetoalign.timelines.beatgrid.SecondsSpec`) | Where the interval opens.  | _required_ |
| end_seconds   | [SecondsSpec](`timetoalign.timelines.beatgrid.SecondsSpec`) | Where the interval closes. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                             | Description                                      |
|--------|----------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
|        | [Fraction](`fractions.Fraction`) | The interval's length in quarter notes, exactly. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                      |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the interval runs backwards, or if either end lies outside the grid's domain. |

### seconds_at { #timetoalign.timelines.BeatGrid.seconds_at }

```python
timelines.BeatGrid.seconds_at(measure, beat=1, *, policy=None)
```

Return the instant of a measure and beat, in seconds.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                                                                 | Description                                                                                                                                                                       | Default    |
|---------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| measure | [int](`int`)                                                         | Measure number in the grid's own numbering.                                                                                                                                       | _required_ |
| beat    | [int](`int`) \| [float](`float`) \| [Fraction](`fractions.Fraction`) | Beat within that measure, 1-based. A fractional beat interpolates between the beats on either side of it.                                                                         | `1`        |
| policy  | [BeatPolicy](`timetoalign.core.BeatPolicy`) \| None                  | Read the beat index under this counting instead of the grid's own lattice — the beat becomes a quarter-note offset from the downbeat, converted back through the segments' tempi. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                        | Description                           |
|--------|---------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------|
|        | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) | The instant, as a seconds coordinate. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                      |
|--------|----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the measure or beat is not one the grid states, or if the position falls outside the measure. |

|        | [int](`int`) | The 0-based index of the segment whose half-open span |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                  |
|--------|----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the position lies before the first segment or at/after the grid's extent. |

### segment_seconds_at { #timetoalign.timelines.BeatGrid.segment_seconds_at }

```python
timelines.BeatGrid.segment_seconds_at(measure, beat=1, *, policy=None)
```

| Name    | Type                                                                 | Description                                                                | Default    |
|---------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| measure | [int](`int`)                                                         | Measure number in the grid's own numbering.                                | _required_ |
| beat    | [int](`int`) \| [float](`float`) \| [Fraction](`fractions.Fraction`) | Beat within that measure, 1-based.                                         | `1`        |

| Name   | Type                                        | Description                                           |
|--------|---------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) | Seconds since the start of the segment containing the |
|        | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) | instant.                                              |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                        |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the measure or beat is not one the grid states. |
